name: week
title: This week
subtitle: What needs attention across every project, rendered by npm run view

sections.title: Rule checks
sections.note: Each line cites its rule in docs/compliance.md.
sections.sql: select rule, project, subject, issue from compliance_issues order by rule, project, subject

sections.title: In the field now
sections.sql: select project, location, type, started_on, final_depth as depth_so_far, planned_depth from location_status where status = 'in progress' order by started_on

sections.title: Lab schedules waiting
sections.sql: select schedule, project, lab, stage, days_in_stage, due_on, tests - reported as tests_waiting from schedule_status where stage <> 'results in' order by days_in_stage desc

sections.title: Piezometers
sections.sql: select location, project, kind, last_read_on, last_depth_m, next_due_on from monitoring_status order by next_due_on

name: lab
title: Laboratory
subtitle: Schedules, results and the index tests side by side

sections.title: Schedules
sections.sql: select schedule, project, lab, sent_on, received_on, due_on, results_on, tests, reported, stage from schedule_status order by sent_on desc

sections.title: Index test results
sections.note: Moisture content, Atterberg limits and fines in percent; strengths in kPa.
sections.sql: select project, location, sample, from_m, legend, mc_pct, ll, pl, pi, fines_pct, cu_kpa, cbr_pct from lab_summary order by project, location, from_m

sections.title: Tubes not scheduled
sections.sql: select project, subject as location, issue from compliance_issues where rule = 'TUBE_SCHEDULE' order by project, subject

name: locations
title: Locations
subtitle: Every borehole, CPT, test pit and hand auger with where its records are up to

sections.title: By location
sections.sql: select project, location, type, status, final_depth, metres_logged, spts, vanes, samples, tests_pending, coord_method, checked_by, nzgd from location_status order by project, location

sections.title: SPT and vane checks
sections.sql: select project, location, depth_m, recorded_n, calculated_n, check_result from spt_results where check_result <> 'ok' order by project, location, depth_m

sections.title: NZ Geotechnical Database
sections.sql: select p.code as project, l.name as location, l.status, l.completed_on, coalesce(l.nzgd_id, '') as nzgd_id, l.nzgd_uploaded_on from locations l join projects p on p.id = l.project_id where p.nzgd_required order by p.code, l.name
